# free-local-ai — GotLaptopParts.com

> Free open-source script that installs a complete private AI stack on any Mac or Windows laptop in 20 minutes. Replaces ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity, and Grammarly subscriptions ($82/month) with free, local, private alternatives.

## What this is

A bash script (Mac) and PowerShell script (Windows) that:
- Detects hardware (RAM, GPU, storage)
- Selects the best AI model for that hardware automatically
- Installs Ollama, LM Studio, Jan.ai, AnythingLLM, and Page Assist
- Downloads and verifies the AI model
- Applies performance optimizations
- Creates a welcome guide explaining how to use everything

## Installs

- Ollama — local AI model runner
- LM Studio — ChatGPT-style chat interface
- Jan.ai — fully offline privacy-first chat
- AnythingLLM — document chat (PDF, Word, etc)
- Page Assist — browser extension for AI on any webpage
- VS Code + Continue.dev + Cline (developer mode only)

## Models installed by hardware tier

- 48GB+ RAM: Llama 3.1 70B Q4
- 24-47GB RAM: Qwen3 32B Q4
- 12-23GB RAM: Llama 3.1 8B Q8
- 6-11GB RAM: Phi-4 Mini

## Subscriptions replaced

- ChatGPT Plus ($20/month)
- Perplexity Pro ($20/month)
- GitHub Copilot ($10/month)
- Claude Pro ($20/month)
- Grammarly Premium ($12/month)
- Total: $82/month → $0 forever
